summary: Reveal a fictional courtyard dwelling while keeping room boundaries and levels legible.
objective: Design a courtyard house I can section vertically to inspect its rooms and roof.
example_prompts: Design a courtyard house I can section vertically to inspect its rooms and roof.
Let me select a room and compare plan and eye-level views.

entities.name: Building shell
entities.guidance: Give slabs thickness, walls actual door/window openings and roof parapet edges.

entities.name: Courtyard and circulation
entities.guidance: Lay out a central open court, doors, sheltered walkway and clear room names.

entities.name: Section cap
entities.guidance: Generate or clearly distinguish a section fill at exposed solids.

object_craft.structure: Give slabs thickness, walls actual door/window openings and roof parapet edges.
object_craft.material: Light plaster, concrete-looking slab edges and darker roof finish.

object_craft.structure: Lay out a central open court, doors, sheltered walkway and clear room names.
object_craft.material: Stone paving with timber-looking threshold details.

object_craft.structure: Generate or clearly distinguish a section fill at exposed solids.
object_craft.material: Flat section hatch or warm neutral cap.

state_contract.model: Authored metric plan dimensions, level elevations, room polygons, active section plane and visibility filters.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.

invariants: Sectioning changes visibility, never room dimensions.
Openings align across wall thickness and frames.
Room labels derive from stable room IDs.
motion_guidance: Move the section plane slowly enough to understand newly exposed boundaries.
Three.js companion tools may handle clipping and picking; geometry construction must own valid openings and caps.
known_limits: Concept design, not structural analysis, permit documentation or code-compliance evaluation.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Courtyard void provides a consistent orientation anchor in both plan and section.

physical_contract.scope: Architectural inspection, no occupants or rigid bodies.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Inspect section cap, room boundaries and opening alignment.
